changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Follow') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[Follow]( [ResourceID] [int] NOT NULL, [ObjectType] [varchar](50) NOT NULL, [ObjectID] [int] NOT NULL, [DateCreated] [datetime] NOT NULL, [FollowTypeID] [int] NULL, [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_Follow] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Follow_ObjectType-ObjectID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Follow_ObjectType-ObjectID] ON [dbo].[Follow] ( [ObjectType] ASC, [ObjectID] ASC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Follow_ResourceID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Follow_ResourceID] ON [dbo].[Follow] ( [ResourceID] ASC ) END

changeSet.author: Puneet Gupta
changeSet.sql: if not exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'Follow' and COLUMN_NAME = 'AssetID') begin alter table [dbo].[Follow] add [AssetID] bigint SPARSE NULL end if not exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'Follow' and COLUMN_NAME = 'AssetTypeID') begin alter table [dbo].[Follow] add [AssetTypeID] int SPARSE NULL end
changeSet.rollback: alter table [dbo].[Follow] drop column if exists [AssetID] alter table [dbo].[Follow] drop column if exists [AssetTypeID]

changeSet.author: Puneet Gupta
changeSet.rollback: if exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'Follow' and COLUMN_NAME = 'ObjectType' and IS_NULLABLE = 'YES') and ((select count(1) from follow where objecttype is null) = 0) begin alter table [dbo].[Follow] alter column [ObjectType] [varchar](50) NOT NULL; end if exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'Follow' and COLUMN_NAME = 'ObjectID' and IS_NULLABLE = 'YES') and ((select count(1) from follow where ObjectID is null) = 0) begin alter table [dbo].[Follow] alter column [ObjectID] int NOT NULL; end IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Follow_ObjectType-ObjectID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Follow_ObjectType-ObjectID] ON [dbo].[Follow] ( [ObjectType] ASC, [ObjectID] ASC ) END
